title: European infrastructure investment landscape — house view May 2026
content: European renewables and grid infrastructure remain a core house overweight. Drivers: continued EU REPowerEU implementation, accelerating grid-connection backlog clearance, and improving cost-of-capital after the most recent ECB cut. Risks: planning-permission timelines in DE and FR, and hedging cost on multi-year USD revenue contracts. We retain Contoso Real Assets Infrastructure as the core access vehicle (XX0000000009); ESG composite 7.6, trailing 12-month yield 4.2%. Suitable for clients with a 7-10y horizon and tolerance for J-curve.
